hero.sub: Work, love or yourself: start from your own chart.
hero.unknown: I don't know my birth time

story.title: Some questions keep following you.
story.body: They surface at midnight, on the way home, or in the middle of a meeting. At those moments, a deep enough point of view can help us take the next step more clearly.
story.q2: Why does my love life keep repeating itself?
story.q3: What am I missing about myself?

ticker.label: Things you can explore
ticker.a3: What does my Life palace say?

explore.title: One chart, many things to read.
explore.lead: Start from the Life palace. Tap Career, Wealth or Spouse to see connections that rarely show when you read one box at a time.
explore.mobileHint: Tap the grid to open the other 8 palaces.
explore.cycles: Beyond the 12 palaces there is a rhythm in time: a ten-year cycle for each decade, an annual cycle for each year.

menh.name: Life
menh.title: Your core self
menh.desc: Temperament, footing, and how you react when things go off course. Every other palace is read from here.

huynh.name: Siblings
huynh.title: Brothers and sisters
huynh.desc: The people who grew up beside you, and how you lift or clash with one another.

phuthe.name: Spouse
phuthe.title: Romance
phuthe.desc: The kind of person you want to stay with, and the differences you need to learn to hear.

tutuc.name: Children
tutuc.title: Children
tutuc.desc: Your bond with children and how you care for the next generation.

taibach.name: Wealth
taibach.title: Money
taibach.desc: Where money comes to you from, and why it sometimes leaves faster than you expect.

tatach.name: Health
tatach.title: Health
tatach.desc: The places your body tends to speak up, so you know when to rest. Not a substitute for medical advice.

thiendi.name: Travel
thiendi.title: Moving away
thiendi.desc: How you change when you leave the familiar: a new job, a new city, a new road.

nobo.name: Friends
nobo.title: Friends and partners
nobo.desc: Who stands with you when things get hard, and which relationships take more than they give.

quanloc.name: Career
quanloc.title: Work
quanloc.desc: The setting where you do your best: structure, stability, or the freedom to decide.

dientrach.name: Property
dientrach.title: Home
dientrach.desc: Settling down, building assets, and the place where you truly feel at home.

phucduc.name: Fortune
phucduc.title: Inner life
phucduc.desc: What keeps you calm, and the family roots behind you.

phumau.name: Parents
phumau.title: Parents
phumau.desc: The tie to your parents and what you carry from the home you grew up in.

needs.title: What do you most want to understand?
needs.lead: A career crossroads. A relationship hard to name. Or yourself, after a long road.

self.title: Understand myself
self.question: Where am I strong? Why do I keep hesitating over big things?
self.path: Read from the Life palace: your character, your footing, and habits you never had a name for.

work.title: Work and money
work.question: Should I quit now? Push hard, or hold onto savings and wait?
work.path: The Career palace shows how you work, the Wealth palace shows cash flow, and the ten-year cycles show the rhythm of each stage.

love.title: Relationships
love.question: Why does the same story keep repeating? What kind of person truly suits me?
love.path: The Spouse palace speaks of the person you bond with easily. Read it with the Life palace to see why.

decision.title: A decision in front of me
decision.question: Sign this contract, accept this trip, or wait a little longer?
decision.path: For one specific question, the I Ching gives a hexagram to weigh whether to move ahead or pause.

needs.lensLead: Zi Wei starts from your own chart. To widen your view, explore the other disciplines.

tuvi.name: Zi Wei Dou Shu
tuvi.desc: A twelve-palace map built from your birth date and time.

batu.name: BaZi
batu.desc: Four pillars of year, month, day and hour, and the balance of the five elements.

chiemtinh.name: Astrology
chiemtinh.desc: Where the planets stood when you were born, read through 12 signs and 12 houses.

kinhdich.name: I Ching
kinhdich.desc: One question, one hexagram, and a hint whether to move or pause.

thansohoc.name: Numerology
thansohoc.desc: Numbers drawn from your name and birth date, and your personal-year rhythm.

compare.title: Do you want an answer, or something to see for yourself?
compare.lead: Every way of looking has something worth choosing. The difference is what you keep after the answer.
compare.tableLabel: Comparing four ways to find an answer

strength.lsv: A chart you can explore, return to, and keep reading.
strength.web: Very fast; many pages offer free lookups.
strength.ai: Flexible: ask in your own words.
strength.thay: Live conversation, and you can dig deeper on the spot.

own.lsv: Starts from your birth date and time; you choose what to understand first.
own.web: Usually returns a ready-made reading; little room to follow your own concern.
own.ai: Answers exactly what you ask, but without reliable chart data the answer can drift.
own.thay: Can be very personal with a careful reader; quality depends on the person.

basis.lsv: Tap an insight to trace it back to the palace and stars behind it.
basis.web: Many readings give conclusions but make it hard to see the links between palaces.
basis.ai: Very fluent; not every sentence points to its basis on the chart.
basis.thay: Can explain in person; afterwards you usually have to write it down yourself to check.

revisit.lsv: Your chart and the sections you opened stay in your account.
revisit.web: Some sites let you save; finding each part again varies.
revisit.ai: Search through chat history; easy to mix up between sessions.
revisit.thay: Memory, a recording, or notes, depending on the session.

depth.lsv: Start free; pick the palace, topic or time period to open next.
depth.web: Usually by article or ready-made package.
depth.ai: Follow up instantly, but you must check the answers yourself.
depth.thay: Follow up instantly if the session still has time.

cost.lsv: See the Lá needed before opening each part.
cost.web: Many pages are free; details may sit in a separate plan.
cost.ai: Depends on the tool plan you use.
cost.thay: Usually paid per session, at each person's rate.

usp.title: Not just a verdict.
usp.lead: Tap a palace to see how it connects. Read an insight to see where it starts. When you want to go further, you choose the parts worth reading.

n1.title: See the connections
n1.body: Pick a palace and its trine and opposite palaces light up together. You see why money is tied to how you work.

n2.title: Trace it to the basis
n2.body: Beside each insight is where it starts on the chart: which palace, which star. You can follow it yourself instead of trusting a vague line.

n3.title: Read deeper by what you need
n3.body: To go further, you pick the part worth reading and see the Lá cost before opening it.

value.title: Read a little first. Go deeper when you want.
value.lead: Begin with the chart and the first things you notice about yourself. To keep it and read on, save your chart. Deeper readings open with Lá, following what you care about.

s1.title: Start free
s1.body: The 12-palace chart and the first things about you, no account needed.

s2.title: Save your chart
s2.body: Sign in to keep your chart, reopen it any time and read the summary.

s3.title: Pick a deeper part
s3.body: Open with Lá, exactly the part you care about. The Lá cost is shown before you agree.

value.packsNote: Each price shows both Lá and money. Pay via VietQR.

faq.title: What you may want to know before starting.

q1.q: What if I don't remember my birth time?
q1.a: You can still begin. Tick “I don't know my birth time”. In the next step, Lá Số Việt explains how birth time matters and lets you add it once you have asked your family.

q2.q: How far does free reading go?
q2.a: You see the 12-palace chart and the first two insights: one about yourself, one about what you choose to care about. No account needed.

q3.a: Lá opens the deeper reading sections. Each pack states its Lá and its price, paid via VietQR.

q4.q: Where can I find my chart again?
q4.a: Sign in to save it. Your chart and the sections you opened live under Account.

about.title: Lá Số Việt began with a simple question: how do you understand a chart, instead of just hearing a verdict?
about.body: We place old knowledge into a closer way of reading: a chart to look at, a basis to trace, and quiet space to understand yourself.
